gleng brjod/ ༄༅༅/ /spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang sku breng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog nas dgongs gzhi dgos pa bla med kyis bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gces skyong gong 'phel gyi rmang gzhi'i sri zhur dmigs te 1970 lor 'di ga bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe mdzod khang 'di bzhin ched du rtsa 'dzugs bskyangs pa ltar/ skabs babs chos rig gang sar spyi sman zhabs 'degs gzhi rgya mi chung ba zhig bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin pa'i ya gyal/ bod bstan srid mi rigs lo rgyus goms srol dang bcas par dus 'gyur rkyen dbang shugs drag gis nyams rgud sna tshogs shig byung dang yong 'gyur blos 'gan bzod bral la brten/ rang re'i skyabs bcol bod mi'i spyi tshogs khongs ser skya zhi drag mi sna rgan rabs rnams kyi zhal rgyun kho nar gnas pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus dang / yul dgon mkhar rdzong gi chags rabs/ ris med skyes chen dang grub thob rnal 'byor pho mo'i mdzad pa rnam thar/ gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bka' dang man ngag zab khrid/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo sogs gdan sa chos brgyud ma lag so so'i mdo sngags phyag bzhes tshog rgyun dang /gar thig dbyangs gsum/ chab blud zhi drag gi sne mo ba dang dpon brgyud/rig gnas dang lag rtsal mkhas pa sogs mi sna grags can rigs kyi lo

gleng brjod/ ༄༅༅/ /spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo mchodag nas dgongs gzhi dbo sa pa bla med kyis sngo/da kyi chodas dang rig gzhung gces skyong gong 'phel gyi rmang gzhi'i sri zhur dmigs te 1970 lor 'di ga bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe mdzod khang 'di bzhin/ ched du rtsa 'dzugs bskyangs pa ltar/ skabs babs chos rig gang sar spyi sman zhabs 'degs gzhi rgya mi chung ba zhig bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin pa'i ya gyal/ thodad bstan srid mi rigs sku/ rgyus goms sku/la dang bcas par dus 'gyur rkyen dbang shugs drag gis nyams rgud sna cho gas shig byung dang yong 'gyur blos 'gan bzod bral la brten/ rang re'i skyabs bathodal cadad mi'i spyi tshogs khongs ser skya zhi drag mi sna rgan rabs rnams kyi zhal rgyun khe/ nar gnas pa'i cadad kyi rgyal rabs 'o/ rgyus dang / yul dgon mkhar rdzong gi chags rabs/ ris med skyes chen dang grub thob rnal 'byor 'o/ mo'i mdzad pa rnam thar/ gsang sngags thun mo nga ma yin pa'i dbang bka' dang man ngag zab khrid/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo sogs gdan sa chos brgyud ma lag so so'i mdo sngags phyag bzhes codag rgyun dang /gar thig dbyangs gsum/ chab srid zhi drag gi sne mo ba dang dpon brgyud/rig gnas dang lag rtsal mkhas pa sku/gas mi sna grags can rigs kyi 'o/

sa1 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/rgyus/ gter dngos khyad nor dang lag rtsal thon khungs/ yul lung yas mas so so'i lo gsar sogs dus ston khag nam dus dang 'brel ba'i zhing 'brog 'tsho ba'i las rtsol rnam grangs/ gnyen sgrig chang sa'i lam srol/ bla slob rim brgyud dang pha tshe bu rabs su brgyud pa'i chos blud las 'bras dang mi spyod ya rabs su spyod pa'i zab gnad ston pa'i ngag gdams bslab bya mi rabs kyi zhal rgyun/ gnag phyugs dang sgo zog sems can skye 'phel skyong gsum sgor/ de bzhin yangs shing rgya che'i gangs can bod rgyal khab chen wa'i mtha' dbus khor yug gangs ri dang /gnas ri/ rtswa thang / chu chen/ mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs kyi gnas babs/ri klung skam gsher du gnas pa'i srog chags spyi sgos kyi rnam grangs dang rang byung khyad chos dang 'brel ba'i khor yug srung skyob skor/ bod rang gi pho mo rgan byis so so'i rtsed mo'i rnam grangs dang / rtsal sbyong / yul lung so so'i pho mo'i chas gos dang rgyan cha'i bye brag lhag par gzhas chen dang / gdangs ring / 'khrug gzhas/ la glu/ 'brog gzhas/ gling sgrung / 'bras dkar dang rbad la sogs pa'i bshad pa'i rnam grangs/ pha gtam bu 'jags kyi kha shags dang gtam dpe/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus mtshon nus kyi dpyad gzhas dang rgyag gtam glu shags sogs mdor na bod mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin khyad chos dang / rgyun 'jags goms gshis bzang wa'i ra sprod mtshon nges brjed du phangs pa rnams da cha mi rabs bajes dang baje mtshams su gtugs pas sdon rjes rgyun mthud zam pa lta bu'i 'gan khur da lta'i mi rabs 'dir 'khri ba rang bzhin yal

51 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/rgyus/ gter dngos khyad nor dang lag rtsal thon khungs/ yul lung yas mas sku so'i 'o/ gsar sku/gas dus stodan khag nam dus dang 'brel ba'i zhing 'asngo/ga 'tsho ba'i las cu la rnam grangs/ gnyen sgrig chang sa'i lam srol/ bla slob rim brgyud dang pha tshe bu rabs su brgyud pa'i chos srid las 'bras dang mi spyod ya rabs su spyod pa'i zab gnad lton pa'i ngag gdams bslab bya mi rabs kyi zhal rgyun/ gnag phyugs dang lha sa ga sems can skye 'phel skyong gsum skor/ de bzhin yangs shing rgya che'i gangs can bod rgyal khab chen wa'i mtha' dbus khor yug gangs ri dang /gnas ri/ rtswa thang / chu chen/ masnu'o dang mtshe'u sogs kyi gnas babs/ri klung skam gsher du gnas pa'i srog chags spyi sgos kyi rnam grangs dang rang byung khyad chos dang 'brel ba'i khor yug srung skyob skor/ bod rang gi pho mo rgan byis so so'i rtsed mo'i rnam grangs dang / rtsal sbyong / yul lung so so'i 'o/ mo'i chas gos dang rgyan cha'i bye brag lhag par gzhas chen dang / gdangs ring / 'khrug gzhas/ la glu/ 'ango ga gzhas/ gling sgrung / 'bras dkar dang rbad la sogs pa'i bshad pa'i rnam grangs/ pha gtam bu 'jags kyi kha shags dang gtam dpe/ 'das pa'i 'o/ rgyus masnu na nus kyi dpyad gzhas dang rgyag gtam glu shags sku/gas masnga/ra na sngo/da mi rigs kyi thun snu/nga ma yin pa'i rang bzhin khyad chodas dang / rgyun 'jags goms gshis bzang wa'i ra ༷ da maco na nges brjed du phangs pa rnams da cha mi rabs brjes dang brje mtshams su gtugs pas lnga na rjes rgyun mthud zam pa lta bu'i 'gan khur da lta'i mi rabs 'dir 'khri ba rang bzhin yal

gleng brjod/ 511 ro/ra du 'jog blo sa ma 'khyud par mkhas myong gnyis can gyi rang rigs bgres sku nga khag rim gshegs 'o/ re je nyung du 'gro bzhin la brten/ rgya gar lho 〈snags gzhis chags khag dang / bal yul/ 'brug yul/ ka rdor sgang gsum/ rda sa/ spi ti/ ki nor/ la dwags/ ma nā swo sogs bod mi 'du sdod sa gnas gang sar da lta 'tsho bzhugs ser skya bgres song khag ched du gdan zhu dang / yang na/ khungs sku sor mi 'bo ched bcar gyi lam nas tho/da ce)la gsum rgya khyab tshang ma'i lo rgyus ci rigs 'tshol zhib sgra sdud 'alta ra thag nang bcug ste gsog sgrub las cadan ched ngag rgyun lo rgyus sde tshan 'di bzhin zur 'dzugs gnang ba ltar 'gan khur yig 'be+eb kyis rang re'i bod mi'i spyi tshogs mang khrod du dar spel sngar lam rgyun 'jags 'byung thabs su deb phreng rim mthud dpar 'don thub thabs khur brtson zhu bzhin yod/ de yang lo rgyus gsung pa po so so'i myong rgyus dbo ngas tshul gang gsungs sku/ra bzhag yig 'bebs gung bsgrigs kyis rgya che'i klog pa wa'i spyan lam du nyams zhib dpyad gzhir dpar 'grems zhu rgyu las ba༄ da dodan rnams la bathodas sgrig gi 'gan dbang spyad med pas 'di ga bod kyi dpe mdzod khang ngam zhu sgrig tshogs chung gi 'dod dbang bsam tshul yin pa'i khyab pa med cing / las don 'di thog 1976 lo nas bzung thog mar gal cher dbo ngas bzhes 'char 'bo da kyis mu mthud thugs khur bzhes mkhan dpe ma17da 'gan 'dzin las zur sku zhabs rgya mtsho tshe ring mchog gis dbus rgyab skyor gnang mkhan sde tshan 'di'i las zur rnam pa/ lhag par las rim 'di thog da phan dpal 'byor gyi rgyab

gleng brjod/ ma11 bor du 'jog blos ma 'khyud par mkhas myong gnyis can gyi rang rigs bgres song khag rim gshegs lo re je nyung du 'gro bzhin la brten/ rgya gar 〉/ tshudags gzhis chags khag dang / bal yul/ 'brug yul/ ka rdor sgang gsum/ rda sa/ spi ti/ ki nor/ la dwags/ ma nā lī sogs bod mi 'du sdod sa gnas gang sar da lta 'tsho bzhugs ser skya bgres song khag ched du gdan zhu dang / yang na/ khungs so sor mi 'gro ched bcar gyi lam nas bod chol gsum rgya khyab tshang ma'i lo rgyus ci rigs 'tshol zhib sgra sdud 'khor thag nang bcug ste gsog sgrub las don ched ngag rgyun lo rgyus sde tshan 'di bzhin zur 'dzugs gnang ba ltar 'gan khur yig 'beb kyis rang re'i bod mi'i spyi tshogs mang khrod du dar spel sngar lam rgyun 'jags 'byung thabs su deb phreng rim mthud dpar 'don thub thabs khur brtson zhu bzhin yod/ de yang lo rgyus gsung pa po so so'i myong rgyus dgongs tshul gang gsungs sor bzhag yig 'bebs gung bsgrigs kyis rgya che'i slog pa wa'i spyan lam du nyams zhib dpyad gzhir dpar 'grems zhu rgyu las brjod don rnams la bcos sgrig gi 'gan dbang spyad med pas 'di ga bod kyi dpe mdzod khang ngam zhu sgrig tshogs chung gi 'dod dbang bsam tshul yin pa'i khyab pa med cing / las don 'di thog 1976 lo nas bzung thog mar gal cher dgongs bzhes 'char 'god kyis mu mthud thugs khur bzhes mkhan dpe mdzod 'gan 'dzin las zur sku zhabs rgya mtsho tshe ring mchog gis dbus rgyab skyor gnang mkhan sde tshan 'di'i las zur rnam pa/ lhag par las rim 'di thog da phan dpal 'byor gyi rgyab

51 1 1 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/rten rgyun mar gnang mkhan rgya gar dbus gzhung dang sngagags ram chosags khag gi bka' drin la rjes dran zhu rgyu dang /deb phreng 25 pa gangs can bod kyi rang byung bdud rtsi sman chab khag gcig gi sngor mtshar khyad cho sa gnad bsdus zhes pa 'di'i lo1 rgyus gsung mi dang / 'brel chags yig cha mtshams rdo ra gnang mkhan gajo 1/ gnas bzang masnu da rten nyi ma'i gnas 'dzen gter cu na dpal hūṃ ri ba gdung rabs dgu pa la chung mchodag sprul 'jigs med rnam rgyal rin 10 che maco ga dang /kham bu chu 'thag gi mi ngo sgangatog rang dbang tshogs chung gi tshogs gtso sku zhabs lhag pa tshe ring lags rnam gnyis la mtha' dpyod bskyar zhib snga phyi zab nan dang sbrags dpe mdzod spyi khyab 'gan 'dzin gyi bka' 'ato/la 'og ngag rgyun so/ rgyus sde tshan nas cadags bsgrigs dpar 'grems zhus//

rigs chos gter ston dpal hūm̐ ri ba'i gsang rnam skal ldan snying gi bdud rtsi/༈ oṃ su sti/ de'ang bod yul chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal g.yas ru gtsang gi khebangs gdodags gam pa lhun grub swā nga gi mnga' cadag gnas mchog mchod rten nyi ma zhes pa 'di ni/ phyi 'o'i dus rabs brgyad par gu ru rin po ches bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su dam pa chos kyi bstan pa btsugs te lto nub rnga g.yab gling du byon nyer/ 'bras ljongs hūm̐ rir gdung 'dzin du 'byon rgyu'i yab mthong mchodag mthong thodal gyi sras phyi ltar rdzi wa'i mtshan can la yi dam rta mgrin gyi zhal gzigs te/ rta maspyodag nas lung bstan 'di ltar bstsal pa:ོ o rgyan chen po lto nub tu phebs pa'i dus nye bar yod do:ོ khyed kyang gsol ba yang yang thobaḥ ces sku gas gsungs pa ltar mahā gu rus zhabs kyis bcags te sa gzhi ri brag thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma rdzi bor sku gcig la mtshan gsum dang ldan cing / phyi ltar bla ma rdzi bo dang / o rgyan chen pos 'dren ma6)ga pad+ma cesas 'phel zhes mtshan du ga1/la zhing / byang phug jo bo gsung byon gyis grub chen nag po spyod pa mthu stobs zhes ga1/la ba de'i gsung sprul sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang hūṃ rir sku bltams te/ dpal sho je gzhon nu'i phur pa gter nas bzhes skor dang / slar gdul bya bod du byung tshul gyi skor zhu bar bya

rigs chos gter ston dpal hūṃ ri ba'i gsang rnam skal ldan snying gi bdud rtsi/sgo ma swa ste/ de'ang bod yul chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal g.yas ru gtsang gi khongs gtogs gam pa lhun grub rdzong gi mnga' 'og gnas mchog mchod rten nyi ma zhes pa 'di ni/ phyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par gu ru rin po ches bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su dam pa chos kyi bstan pa btsugs te lto nub rnga g.yab gling du byon nyer/ 'bras ljongs hūṃ rir gdung 'dzin du 'byon rgyu'i yab mthong mchog masang grol gyi sras phyi ltar rdzi ngo'i mtshan can la yi dam rta mgrin gyi zhal gzigs te/ rta mchog nas lung bstan 'di ltar bstsal pa: yo rgyan chen po lho nub tu phebs pa'i dus nye bar yod do: khyed kyang gsol ba yang yang sgobaḥ ces sogs gsungs pa ltar mahā gu rus zhabs kyis bcags te sa gzhi ri brag thams cad byin kyis brlabs/ bla ma rdzi bor sku gcig la mtshan gsum dang ldan cing / phyi ltar bla ma rdzi bo dang / o rgyan chen pos 'dren mchog pad+ma chos 'phel zhes mtshan du gsol zhing / byang phug jo bo gsung byon gyis grub chen nag po spyod pa mthu stobs zhes gsol ba de'i gsung sprul sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang hūṃ rir sku bltams te/ dpal do je gzhon nu'i phur pa gter nas bzhes skor dang / slar gdul bya bod du byung tshul gye skor zhu bar bya

22 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/ba la/ thog mar 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas hūṃ ri zhes pa der sdod pa'i ma gcig la bu mo gcig rang yod cing / khong ma mad kyi 'alnga'i rten ba phyugs kho na yin/ bu mo nyin ltar ba phyugs rnams 'tsho bar 'gro gi yod/ nub gcig bu sdu'i sma lam du mi gos dkar gyon pa zhig nas mo la ril bu gcig sbyin par smas/ de zas ma thag lus sems la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde ba ha cang 'bar ba'i mtshan ma khyad par can zhig byung /de nas nyin 'ga' shas kyi rjes su lus sngo phran bu ma bde ba zhig chags pas/ de nas zla ba 'ga' tsam sku nga skabs su'ang lus po bde min de rang la gnas stabs/ sman pa khag la bsten pas sman pa kha shas nas skran nad yin tshul brjod pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig nas nad ngo ma 'phrod par rang gar lus shing / bu mo'ang nyin ltar ba phyugs 'tsho bar phyin te char pa sogs babs skabs brag phug zhig gi nang sdod kyi sku da pa dang / de nas bu rmo'i lto ba rim bzhin je cher song bar brten/ a ma de'ang blo ma bde bar bu mor byi phrug 'dra chags pa min nam snyam ste/ a mas bu mor khyod la byi phrug gcig 'khor yod pa 'dra/ de'i pha su yin nga la drang por lha da dgos lab pas/ a ma lags nga la zla cad med par phru gu skye rgyu ga la coding zhes brjod pas/ skran nad yin par cha bzhag bu mo 'ang rang 'jags ba phyugs kyi rjes su 'gro bzhin pa dang / nyin gcig char sim zhig babs skabs sngar gyi brag phug de'i nang sdod skabs glo bur du lto bar na zug drag po zhig brgyab nas de'i rjes grod thum lta bu zhig gsang ba'i pad+ma nas thon te/ phyi dro mo/ rang gi nad de thon sku/nga snyam nas ba phyugs

24 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/chos rgyal dang po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis kyang gsan nas/ mthar mi ser tshang mas nyin gcig phan tshun du btsal kyang gong bzhin ma rnyed/ de nas lha btsun chen pos/ da cha su la'ang ma rnyed tshe nga tsho gsum hūṃ sgra de rang rtsad gcod par 'gro dgos kyi yod pa yin 'gro gsungs nas/ rgyal ba lha btsun chen po dang / mnga' bdag sems dpa' chen po/ gaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po bcas yug sam nas hūṃ rir phebs thon mdzad/ hūm̐ sgra de sngar bzhin ri rtse na 'dug snyam na shod na yod pa lta bu byung bar brten/ lha btsun chen pos/mnga' bdag khyed lo na chung bas hūṃ sgra de gar yod legs par rtsad gcod dgos bka' phebs bzhin/ mnga' bdag mchog shod la 'tshol bar byon skabs hūṃ sgra ri rtser sgrogs pa lta bu byung bas/ lha btsun chen ya'i gzigs snang la bya thang dkar zhig brag phug nang 'dzul ba gzigs te/ hūm̐ sgra gar sgogs gsan skabs brag phug de'i nang ngos nas sgogs pa gsan stabs/ de'i phyogs su phebs pa dang brag phug nang nas thang dkar zhig phyir thon pa gzigs/ de nas brag phug gi nang nas hūm̐ sgra ches cher sbru/gas pa gsan pas/bla ma rnam pa gsum pos gzhan du 'tshol bar ma byon par brag phug de'i nang gzigs par phebs skabs/ hūṃ sgra sgog mkhan de ni khye'u chung chung zhig gis sgog shin yod par ngo mtshar cher bskyed nas/ khye'u de rgyal ba lha btsun chen gro'i sgu gzan la 'dril nas phyag tu bsnams te/ dgyes tshor chen ya'i ngang yug sam nor bu sgang du zhabs sor 'khod/rgyal ba lta btsun chen pos chos rgyal mchog la da bar hūm̐ sgra sgog mkhan ni khye'u 'di red ces gsungs par rgyal pos kyang khye'u de ngo mtshar

dpal hūm̐ ri ba'i gsang rnam skal ldan snying gi bdud rtsi/ 29bzang po/ bzhi pa rig 'dzin 'chi med dbang po/ lnga pa rig 'dzin dbang rgyal/ drug pa rig 'dzin drag rtsal rdo rje/ bdun pa rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rtogs ldan dpa' bo/ brgyad pa rig 'chirdon grags pa rgyal mtshan/dgu pa bdag rta mgrin tshe dbang ngam 'jigs med rnam rgyal du 'thodad pa bcas yin/ gong gi gdung rabs gsum pa nas brgyad pa bar gyi bla ma rnams nas gsang sngags kyi sgrub pa nyams len gtso thodar mdzad cing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa sha stag byung 'dug gong ma de dag nas grub rtags bzang ngo'i rigs byung lugs yul mi rgan rabs kyi ngag lam nas baljagad srol so/ rgyus ji snyed 'dug kyang yig tshogs la 'jigs te 'dir bkod med zhu/ da lam skabs su babs pa gus pa rang nyid kyi rang rnam lo rgyus snying bsdus su zhu bar bya ba ni/de yang sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gangs can mdzod lnga'i byang sgo'i 'dabs snga la du 'kho da pa/ gnas mchog mchod rten nyi mar yab rje rig 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / ma lha dbang bu 'khrid gnyis kyi bur rab byung 16 pa'i lcags yos phyi lo 1951 bod zla 2 tshes 10res gza' spen pa'i nyin rta mgrin drag wa'i lha khang gi nye 'dabs gzim chung phun tshogs ho/ brang nang skyes/ yab rje mchog nas ming rta mgrin tshe dbang zhes btags pa gnang / rang lo 7 sku na skabs bod du dus zing langs te lhing 'jags med par brten/ nyen g.yol lta bur yab rje ston 'khor rnams sbas yul lta nag brgyud la chen du phebs te der 'o/ gcig bzhugs/de nas byang 'bras ljongs kyi rdzong khongs man gan du dgun thog gcig der

86 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/nas gdan sa'i gtso bo bkra shis sdings su bzhugs te rnying ma rgyud 'bum gye chos 'khor bskor cing / myong grol bdud rtsi 'dzad med du 'jo ba'i bum pas 'bo/ ba mtha' dag 'aX/ra ba las 'dren pa'i dus mchod so/ re bzhin cho 'phrul zla ba'i mas brgyad nas bco lnga'i nyin bar tshogs pa'i skal ldan dga' ston rtag tu 'gyed pa ngo mtshar blud na mtho bar mchis/de ltar sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs 'dir sprul pa'i rnal 'byor mched bzhi nas dam pa'i ce sa kyi bstan pa'i sa/la btsugs pa'i bka' drin la brten nas yang zab rdzogs pa chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i chos rgyun rnams dus da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bshad sgrub kyi sdes skyong bzhin pa 'bras ljongs rdzogs chen gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa de ltar mchis so//de ltar rnam thar lam bzang bris pa'i dges/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i las nyon byang ba dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad rab brtan cing / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar 'char shog ces pa'ang gong gi rnal 'byor mched bzhi'i dus skabs su 'bras mo ljongs kyi rigs chos gter ston dpal hūm̐ ri ba'i rgyud 'dzin dgu pa la chung bla ming 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis phul// / /

86 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/nas gdan sa'i gtso bo bkra shis sdings su bzhugs te rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi chos 'khor bskor cing / myong grol bdud rtsi 'dzad med du 'jo ba'i bum pas 'bo ba mtha' dag 'kho ra ba las 'dren pa'i dus macesad so/ re bzhin cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad nas bco lnga'i nyin bar mārgags pa'i skal ldan dga' lha na rtag tu 'gyed pa sngo mtshar srid na mchod bar mchis/de ltar sbas yul 'bras mo jongs 'dir sprul pa'i rnal 'byor mched bzhi nas dam pa'i cesas kyi bstan pa'i lha/la btsugs pa'i bka' drin la brten nas yang zab cadags pa chen sngo gathe cadar gyur pa'i chos rgyun rnams dus da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bshad sgrub kyi sdes skyong bzhin pa 'bras ljongs rdzogs chen gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa de ltar mchis so//de ltar rnam thar lam bzang bris pa'i dges/ /mkha' mnyam 'aspo ba'i las nyon byang ba dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad rab brtan cing / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar 'char shog ces pa'ang gong gi rnal 'khyodar mched bzhi'i dus skabs su 'bras snu ljo ngas kyi rigs chos gter ston dpal hūm̐ ri ba'i rgyud 'dzin dgu pa la chung bla ming 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis phul// / /

sbas yul mkha' spyod gnyis pa kham bu sman chab kyi phan sku/na ut+pal kha phye ba /༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru pañca la/ /gang gi thugs je'i 'od zer rab bkye nas//'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung ma lus kun/ /sel mdzad sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshungs zad drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lha tshogs dang / /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sman gye lha mo sogs/ /bstan srung ma mgon lcam dral 'khor rgya mtsho/ /bod skyong bstan ma bcas pas bdag skyongs shig /7rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yang sprul gyes/ /'gro ba'i gcong nad drungs nas yul 'don zhing / /nad brgya sman gcig 'chi bdag zhags gcod dpal/ /ngo mtshar ye shes bdud rtsir snying nas dad/ ces bstod nas/ lho phyogs 'dzam gling gi ste ba/rgya gar rdo je gdan gyi byang phyogs/ ri bo kai la sha yi lho rgyud du gtogs/ pa thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+mo dang / je btsun 'phags ma sgol ma/ rigs 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs kyis che cher byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas gnas khyad par can mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs/ 'bras mo gshongs/'bras mo rin chen khud sogs kyi le lag tu gyur pa/ slob dpon chen pa'i bka' gter du ma lasastob rgyan sman bu yul zhes grags kyang / 'jig rten

sbas yul mkha' ྅ da gnyis pa kham bu sman chab kyi phan yon ༷/t+pal kha phye ba /༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru pañca la/ /gang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer rab bkye nas//'gro ba'i nyon mongs tsha gdung ma lus kun/ /sel mdzad sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshungs med drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug lha tshogs dang / /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sman gyi lha mo sogs/ /bstan srung ma mgon lcam dral 'khor rgya mtsho/ /bod skyong bstan ma bcas pas bdag skyongs shig /7rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yang sprul gyis/ /'gro ba'i gcong nad drungs nas yul 'don zhing / /nad brgya sman gcig 'chi bdag zhags gcod dpal/ /1ra mtshar ye shes bdud rtsir snying nas dad/ ces bstod nas/ lto phyogs 'dzam gling gi ste ba/rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ ri bo kai la sha yi lho rgyud du gtogs/ pa thugs rje chen sngo phyag na pad+mo dang / rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma/ rigs 'dzin chen sngo/ pad+ma 'byung gnas sku gas kyis che cher byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas gnas khyad par can mkha' lhamad 'bras snu/ cadangs/ 'bras mo gshongs/'bras mo rin chen khud sogs kyi le lag tu gyur pa/ hrī ba dpon chen ngo'i bka' gter du ma lasastog rgyan sman bu yul zhes grags kyang / 'jig rten

88 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/phal tshig tu kham bu lung zhes byar 'bod pa 'di'i gnas kyi lte ba gu ru'i gsung las/ /sbas yul sman bu lung zhes bya ba na/ /ri yi rgyal wa sku gsum sgrub pa la/ /phyi ltar rdza brag spang dang sman gyi ljongs/ /rang byon rang gter gnas rnams khyad 'phags yod/ /nang ltar rang byung zangs dang lcags kyi gter/ /skal ldan lcags zam la sogs gter la khyodad//gsang ba bla med sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing / /dad ldan rnal 'byor pho mo grub pa thob/ /ri bo de yi g.yas phyogs rdza ljongs na/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sel ba yi/ /tsha chu grang chu'i rigs ni dpag med yod/ de nyid kyi ni yon tan zur du gsal/ zhes dang /yang bka' thang las/ /sman bu tse/ rgyan brag gi lte ba la/ /myong grol aḥrgya ril bu bre bcu sbas/ /de yi rtsal las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun//babs pa'i tsha chu grang chu dpag med sku/da/ ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sku na tan khyad par can zur du yod pa re zhig ma gsal yang / 'dir ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i tsha chu dang grang chu'i rigs mi 'dra ba dpag med sku da pa rnams kyi rgyu jo nga zhi rigs nyer lnga dang / mu zi rigs bcu sogs kyi rkyen rdo sol las skyes pa/ rdo sol shed che chung gi chu tsha grang dang / nad tsha grang gi phan gnod dbye ba'ang des 'byed cing / grang chu'i rigs rdo sol med pa'i gong gi rgyu rnams dang /sman gyi shing dang / sman dpag med skyes pa'i ljongs kyi rtsi bcud babs te bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la bsten pas rang gis dad mos bgyirid na 7rgyal ba rnams kyis gang la gang 'dul gyi mchog sprul dngari bcas rang cadan dang /

kham bu sman chab kyi phan yon ut+pal kha phye ba/ 89tsha chu sogs su skur sprul nas de dang de'i don mdzad par zhal gyes bzhes pa mdo rgyud du mar gsal ba spros ma dgos shing / sngon du chu rnams 'phrod pa'i dpung bskyed du rang rang gi 'khos 'byor dang bsnyun nas gnas dgon rnams la bsnyen bkur tshogs mchod dang / bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sman srung zhang chodan snu/gas yul 'di'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams la bsangs gasdu/la dang / gsol mchod gnad du smin pa'i sgo nas nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba'i gsol 'debs 'khrin bcol dang 'brel ba'i kun slong khyad par can 'di ltar bsam zhing / ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du 7rgyal kun thugs rje'i chab bsil 'dir 'jug pa'i yun la bdag gzhan thams cad kyi nad ga'o/na sdig sgrib rnams dag nas sa/ rgyan sman gyi bla ma'i go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya snyam pa'i ngang nas dad gus drag pos sgo gsum bag yod kyis ji ltar pakhro'i mtsho la ngur pa'i khyu tshogs 'jug pa bzhin du chu rnyog pa dang dkrug pa sogs ma yin par gsol 'debs ngang ngur sgrog bzhin par phan tshun 'thab rtsod dang / zur za sogs spangs te byams brtse'i ngang tshul gyis rang rang gi nad thog tu chu bcud kyi dwangs ma len par dal bus zhugs par bya'o/gu ru'i gsung las/ /sems can sgyu lus 'jigs pa'i nad byung tshe/ /mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na/ /yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs/ /o rgyan sman gye bla dang dbyer med nga/sa/ /tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel/ /sa/ rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gas/la

90 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/ba 'debs/ bsam pa lhun gyes 'grub par byin gyis cho bas/ zhes sa/gas gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus la 'bad par bya'o/1 de nas sgog mar lha mo rdzing zhes bya ba/ /rdo je kun grags ma la gnyer gtad pa/ 'dir 'khrud bya zhing / rdzing bu'e yon tan ni//sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen du gyur pa'i gegs/ /grib dang mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad sbyang / /rgyu ni snu/ ༄ nga dkar las grub pa yin/ /nad ni bad rlung mgo 'khor khrag dang mkhris/ /chu ser gsar rnying kun sela.e ma mtshar/ /gzhan yang tshad pa'i nad rigaru/ phal cher sel/2 de nas bya rgod rdzing zhes bya ba ni/ sngon bya rgod po zhig gi gshog pa chag nas rdzing der lhung / zhag bdun la gsos nas 'phur thub pas ming de ltar chags shing / phan sku/na ni/ /chab de'i rgyu ni gtso bo mo ljang las grub pa/ /nad ni mgo nad rus pa gas chag dang / /reg dug rkang 'bam nad dang rmu chu'i 'jug skya gzer stod khengs klad gzer stod gzer 'joms/ /khyad par grum bu dkar nag khra gsum sel/ /'di nyid kong btsun rdo je dpal la gtad/ ces so/3 de nas dpon rdzing ngam ya ma rdzing zhes bya ba'i chab rdzing 'di'i rgyu ni/ rdzing byang mu zi dkar po dang / /rdzing lho mu zi nag po dag las grub/ /nad ni khrag mkhris rus blun rlung blun 1/gas/ /ya ma dkar nag khra gsum 'joms par byed/ /de yang sto mas slong

90 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/ba 'debs/ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis 〉〉bas/ zhes sku/gas gasnu la 'debs rgyas bsdus la 'bad par byacad/1 de nas thog mar lha mo rdzing zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje kun grags ma la gnyer gtad pa/ 'dir 'khrud bya zhing / rdzing bu'e yon tan ni//sgyu na gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen du gyur pa'i gegs/ /grib dang mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad sbyang / /rgyu ni snu jo nga dkar las grub pa yin/ /nad ni bad rlung mabo 'kho ra khrag dang mkhris/ /chu ser gsar rnying kun selalge ma mtshar/ //gzhan yang tshad pa'i nad rigs/ phal cher sel/na de nas bya rgod rdzing zhes bya ba ni/ sngon bya rgod po zhig gi gshog pa chag nas rdzing der lhang / zhag bdun la gsos nas 'phur thub pas ming de ltar chags shing / phan yon ni/ /chab de'i rgyu ni gatho ngo snu ljang las grub pa/ /nad ni mthod nad rus pa gas chag dang / /reg dug rkang 'bam nad dang rmu chu'i 'jug skya gzer stod khengs klad gzer stod gzer 'joms/ /khyad par grum bu dkar nag khra gsum sel/ /'di nyid kong btsun rdo rje dpal la gtad/ ces so/3 de nas dpon rdzing ngam ya ma rdzing zhes bya ba'i chab rdzing 'di'i rgyu ni/ rdzing byang mu zi dkar po dang / /rdzing rdzo mu zi nag po dag las grub/ /nad ni khrag mkhris rus srin rlung srin 14gas/ /ya ma dkar nag khra gsum 'joms par byed/ /de yang lto mas slong

kham bu sman chab kyi phan yonaphasat+pal kha phye ba/ 91zhing byang mas 'joms/ /mkhris pa k+ṣa ya'i (dkar nag )nad kyang 'di yis sel/ /lo rgan yar 1/nga mkhal rked na ba dang / /rkang nad dreg grum la sogs skyon can rnams/ /rdzing der sbang tshe rked pa gzhu ltar gug /rkang pa mda' ltar drang zhing 'gro mi shes/ /de gnyis shes par mdzod la spang bar gces/ /byang rdzing gnyer kha rdo je spyan gcig dang / /lho rdzing rdo je g.yang ma skyong la gtad/4 /brag sked rdzing gi rgyu ni mu zi dang / /cong zhi pho mo gnyis tsam sdebs pa yin/ /phan sku/na chu ser nad dang skya babs dang / /mig nad rna nad snying nad sel bar byed/ /khyad par khrag mkhris nad kyi gshed ma yin/ /gnyer kha ro/ rje grags rgyal ma la gtad/5 /thang rdzing zhes pa'i rgyu ni rdo sol dang / /cong zhi las grub phan sku/na ni/ /dreg dang grum bu mdze dang rkang 'bam dang / /mkhal rked gnad 'gram sa/gas la shin tu phan/ /drang 11nga gza' nad la phog 'dzem par gces/ /'di yi bdag po 〉/ rjo kun grags yin/6 /gser nya rdzing gi rgyu ni pho cong gtso bo dang / /phan yon bad gan skya ser rlung nad dang / /mkhal nad grang nad chu snyi grum bu dreg/smad nad kun la dus mtha'i me+e ltar mtshungs/ /mig la cung zad phog pas 'dzem par gces/ /'di nyid 'brog chen rdo je'i bgegs kyi gtso bor gtad/7 /bad khrag rdzing gi rgyu ni ma ning dang / /mo cong mu zi gser yang cung zad 'dres/ /de yi yon tan slo nad mchin mcher nad/ /bad

kham bu sman chab kyi phan yonaskusdut+pal kha phye ba/ 91zhing byang mas 'joms/ /mkhris pa k+ṣa ya'i (dkar nag )nad kyang 'di yis sel/ /so/ rgan yar lha/nga mkhal rked na ba dang / /rkang nad dreg grum la sogs skyon can rnams/ /rdzing der sbang tshe rked pa gzhu ltar gug /rkang pa mda' ltar drang zhing 'gro mi shes/ /de gnyis shes par mdzod la spang bar gces/ /byang rdzing gnyer kha rdo rje spyan gcig dang / /rdzo rdzing rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong la gtad/4 /brag sked rdzing gi rgyu ni mu zi dang / /khyodang zhi sngo mo gnyis tsam sdebs pa yin/ /phan sku/na chu ser nad dang skya babs dang / /mig nad rna nad snying nad sel bar byed/ /khyad par khrag mkhris nad kyi gshed ma yin/ /gnyer kha rdo rje grags rgyal ma la gtad/5 /thang rdzing zhes pa'i rgyu ni jo snu la dang / /cong zhi las grub phan sku na ni/ /dreg dang grum bu mdze dang rkang 'bam dang / /mkhal rked gnad 'gram lha/gas la shin tu phan/ /drang sku/nga gza' nad la 'o/ga 'dzem par gces/ /'di yi bdag po sna rjo kun grags yin/6 /gser nya rdzing gi rgyu ni pho cong gtso bo dang / /phan yon bad kan skya ser rlung nad dang / /mkhal nad grang nad chu snyi grum bu dreg/smad nad kun la dus mtha'i me ltar mtshungs/ /mig la cung zad phog pas 'dzem par gces/ /'di nyid 'brog chen rdo rje'i bgegs kyi ga3/ ro/ra gtad/7 /bad khrag rdzing gi rgyu ni ma ning dang / /snu cong mu zi gser yang cung zad 'dres/ /de yi sku/na tan blo nad mchin mcher nad/ /bad

92 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/kan skya ser gsar rnying thams cad dang / /khyad par 'dus nad skug ྅/ra shin tu phan/ /dug nad la'ang phan pas shes par bya//zur za rlung la phog pas bag yod gyis/ /'di nyid mkha' lding rdo rje klu mor gtad/8 /bla ma rdzing gi rgyu ni sdu/ ྅5nga dang / /mu zi nag po las grub yon tan ni/ /chu ser gsar dang bad kan skya bo dang / /mgo nad rtsa byer nad la phan par bshad/ /'di nyid jo rje sman gcig ma la gtad/9 /brag rgyab rtsadakar rdzing gi rgyu zhi pho cong ser/ /mu zi ljang khu yang ni cung zad 'dres/ /yon tan bad kan nad dang mkhris pa dang //pho rgyu chu ser rigs dang pags nad dang / /khyad par rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis dang ni/ /drang lha/nga chu nad la yang e ma ho/ /'di la tse/ rgyan mkha' 'borware gsang gnas nas/ /bdud rtsi thun mtshams rnams su ye shes kyi/ /byang sems 'bab pas dad ldan gang zag la/ /dngos grub sne re yod pas len shes mdzod/ /'di ni rdo rje g.ya' ma sil nyid yin/10 /rdzing pho rdzing gi rgyu ni mu zi nag /brag cong 'o/ mo 'dres pa'i yon tan ni/ /ho skran grang skran skran ྅ nad nga dang / /me drod gso zhing mkhal nad grang nad dang / /lhang pa sbos skrangs bsam bse'u nad dang ni/ /khyad par mdze nad bse dug nad la bsngags/ /khrag tshad mkhris shed can rnams 'dzem bag gyis/ /'di nyid mnga' bdag rdo rje zur legs yin/

92 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/gan skya ser gsar rnying thams cad dang / /khyad par 'dus nad spug ྅/ra shin tu phan/ /dug nad la'ang phan pas shes par bya//zur za rlung la phog pas bag yod gyes/ /'di nyid mkha' sding rdo je klu mor gtad/8 /bla ma rdzing gi rgyu ni mo cong dang / /mu zi nag po las grub yon tan ni/ /chu ser gsar dang bad gan skya bo dang / /mgo nad rtsa byer nad la phan par bshad/ /'di nyid rdo je sman gcig ma la gtad/9 /brag rgyab rtsadakar rdzing gi rgyu ni pho cong ser/ /mu zi ljang khu yang ni cung zad 'dres/ /yon tan bad gan nad dang mkhris pa dang //pho rgyu chu ser rigs dang pags nad dang / /khyad par rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis dang ni/ /drang srong chu nad la yang e ma ho/ /'di la sa/ rgyan mkha' 'bo re gsang gnas nas/ /bdud rtsi thun mtshams rnams su ye shes kyi/ /byang sems 'bab pas dad ldan gang zag la/ /dngos grub sne re yod pas len shes mdzod/ /'di ne+e rdo je g.yang ma sil nyid yin/10 /rjing pho rdzing gi rgyu ni mu zi nag /brag cong pho mo 'dres pa'i yon tan ni/ /pho skran grang skran skran rdo nad pa dang / /me drod gso zhing mkhal nad grang nad dang / /sgang pa sgos skrangs bsam bse'u nad dang ni/ /khyad par mdze nad bse dug nad la bsngags/ /khrag tshad mkhris shed can rnams 'dzem bag gyis/ /'di nyid mnga' bdag rdo je zur legs yin/

kham bu sman chab kyi phan mo/na ut+pal kha phye ba/ 9311 /nub rdzing zhes pa cong zhi pho mor grub/ de yi yon tan dreg dang grum bu dang / /rkang 'bam nad dang grang khrag thur du babs/ /chu ser tshigs sgril rma 'gras shu rgan dang / /lus nad ma lus sel ba'i gnyen ngo'i mdzadag /'di nyid sman chu kun gyi rgyal sngo/ yin//'on kyang bad rlung stod khrag rgyas pa dang / /mkhris pa stod gzer sogs la phog pas 'dzems/ /'di nyid bod khams rdo rje skyong la gtad/ /shin tu gnyan pas bag sku/da bsten par mato/da/12 ar phrug rdzing gsar dpon slob ces pa'i rgyu/ /pho cong zhi la ma ning cung zad 'dres/ /phan yon grang ba dkar dmar 'dzag pa dang / /mkhal skran dpye mig gzer nad thams cad dang / /rma 'gras rma rgan la yang bsngags pa dang / /bad gan nad la phan pa mkhas pas bzhed/ /'di nyid bstan srung zhang blon chen por gtad//de nas so so'i nad ngo bzung ba'i thog /nad sgog sman chu sbangs pa yun ring thung / /rang rang lus zungs dag la dpag pas bsten/ /sman chu sbangs zin rlangs pa ma shor bar/ /gos stan rnams kyis sgril ba gnad du che/ /de ltar zhugs lugs sman gyi rgyud rnams las/ /rta pa zhag gcig ngal gso bsten par bya/ /nad ngos bzung zhing nas 'dra'i gzugs ltar bsten/ /rjes bas/sa mar dkar dwangs mas lus kun byug /mi grang mi dro snyoms pa'i las kun byed/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin nyams su len par bya/ /deng sang nad pa thag ring nas yong ba/ /lus kun 'khrug ste nad khrag zungs khrag gnyis/ /ma phye sman chu sbangs pa glen pa'i lugs/

kham bu sman chab kyi phan yon ༷/t+pal kha phye ba/ 9311 /nub rdzing zhes pa cong zhi pho mor grub/ de yi yon tan dreg dang grum bu dang / /rkang 'bam nad dang grang khrag thur du babs/ /chu ser tshigs sgril rma 'gras shu rgan dang / /lus nad ma lus sel ba'i gnyen wa'i mchodag /'di nyid sman chu kun gyi rgyal sngo yin//'on kyang bad rlung stod khrag rgyas pa dang / /mkhris pa stod gzer sogs la phog pas 'dzems/ /'di nyid bod khams rdo rje skyong la gtad/ /shin tu gnyan pas bag sku/da bsten par macesad/12 ar phrug rdzing gsar dpon slob ces pa'i rgyu/ /pho cong zhi la ma ning cung zad 'dres/ /phan yon grang ba dkar dmar 'dzag pa dang / /mkhal skran dpyi mig gzer nad thams cad dang / /rma 'gras rma rgan la yang bsngags pa dang // /bad kan nad la phan pa mkhas pas bzhed/ /'di nyid bstan srung zhang sdudan chen por gtad//de nas so so'i nad ngo bzung ba'i thog /nad thog sman chu sbangs pa yun ring thung / /rang rang lus zungs dag la dpag pas bsten/ /sman chu sbangs zin rlangs pa ma shor bar/ /bo sa stan rnams kyis sgril ba gnad du che/ /de ltar zhugs lugs sman gyi rgyud rnams las/ /rta pa zhag gcig ngal gso bsten par bya/ /nad ngos bzung zhing nas 'dra'i gzugs ltar bsten/ /rjes bcos mar dkar dwangs mas lus kun byug /mi grang mi dro snyoms pa'i las kun byed/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin nyams su len par bya/ /deng sang nad pa thag ring nas yong ba/ /lus kun 'khrug ste nad khrag zungs khrag gnyis/ /ma phye sman chu sbangs pa glen pa'i lugs/

94 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos//gnas skabs ngal gasku dwangs snyigs phye ba gces/ /de nas rim bzhin 'jug pa mkhas pas bzhed/ /bho phyogs ma la ya yi ri wa'i dbus/ /'jig rten khams na tsha chu grangs mang yang / /kham bu'i chu tshan 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi dkon/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin ma rtog par/ /dug gsum las skyes bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /sman chu gcig gis 'joms pa dpa' thod yin/ /mjo nga ba tsam gyis nyi cadad ba snu bzhin/ /gar sku/nga cha med dengs pa.e ma lha / /yun ring song na grol ba slos ci dgos/ /bden rdzun yin min zhag bdun cadang dang shes/ /'di nyid chu zhag bdun gsum spyod nus na/ /dam sdom nyams dang rigs rus mnol ba dang / /sdig sgrib bag chags ngan pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /'byung 'khrug nad rims gartsodan bgegs la sogs pa/ sngar yod phyi nang nad ro kun sangs nas/ /seṅge'i rtsal dang stobs gad (gyad )glang chen dang / /mgyogs pa rta ltar zil mdangs me dosnag bzhin/ /rgyas nas ga3rten sha chags shing 'chi bdag gi/ /zhags nag gcod la 'di las lhag pa ci/ /dal rten u dum wa ra'i me tog gi//gso byed ye shes bdud rtsi ngo mtshar che/ /nad ngo mi zin sman dang dpyad log gi/ /'dod pa can gyi lha rje stong las lhag /de bas 'di nyid rtag tu khyodad par rig ces sman chab yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sku na tan phan sku na rgya masto lta bu la/ /bdag 'dra thos chung rnams kyis brjod mi langs/ /'on kyang gzhan phan lhag bsam ༷ la med kyi/ /rang mnyam blun ho/ngas rnams la phan ched du/ /chu thigs tsam zhig 'di ru smras pa la/ /nongs par gyur na sman gyi bla mar bshags/ zhes pa'i 'gro ba'i dug lnga'i nad 'joms

kham bu sman chab kyi phan yonacasat+pal kha phye ba/ 95nas/ /sku lnga ye shes myur du 'thob par shog ces pa lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med rtsal dang / mkhas grub dz+nya nas mdzad pa dag byed bdung/ rtsi'i ma yig phyi snu/ rnams/ 'brug yig lta bu'i ma dag rgyun 'byams dang / chad lhag ci cher brten shes blo'i pad+mo 'dzum zhing dad brtse'i zil bcud mngar ba gnas mo chodas dbyings kyi ngag rgyun ltar/ rigs sngag/sa 'chang ba'i gdung 'dzin gzhon nu yid kyi 'khri shing gnas mo dang bu bzhuganyis kyi bka' ngo ldog med tsam du chad lhag rnams kha bskangs shing cung zad dag par zhus khul gyis kun mkhyen gser sprul rig brgya jo— rjo'i bka' 'bangs tha shal sprang ban lha mas las rgya rje/na pas mi shes bzhin du sug bris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ /e ma rab 'byams rgyal kun thugs rje'i chab bsil gyis/ /rab mnar 'bo ba'i gcong nad drung phyung bas/ /rab bzang kham bu'i chu tshan phan sku na 'di/ /rab dkar lhag bsam dag pa'i gsar du bsgrigs/ kun mkhyen gser sprul bla ma'i bka' 'bangs tha kun tu 'khyams pa sprang ban rgya snru/na pas/ sarba maṅga waṃ// //sbas yul mkha' ྅7da gnyis pa kham bu sman chab kyi phan yon ut+pal kha phye ba zhes pa'i chu yig ma dpe bris ma 'di bzhin phag ri rnam rgyal dkar ngo'i swā nga khongs kham bu chu 'thag khyim tshang gi mi thor sku zhabs lhag pa tshe ring nas da bar rgya gar dang bod du thabs 'tshol ci drag gnang yang ma phyi khungs btsun lag swon ma thub par yun ring lus shing /'phags yul byang sdudags bzhugs sgar rda ram sa la dbus sman rtsis khang gi slob dpon sku gshegs lha rje blo bzang chos 'phel lags dang / deng

gu ru'i gsung bstan ma brtsus kyi sgos gasku la rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med/༈ོ :ོk+ṣiṃ dza:ོ dza: /ma mi bzad dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:/lcags kyi drel rta rkang gsum khri stengs na:ོ /ma gcig dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma rki:ོ /brjid cing 'gying ba'i tshul gyi bzhugs su galha/la:ོ /ma hi ku la pad+ma sam bha wa:ོ /sa ma ya taXsnro lhan:ོ /ma mi masngaran nam mkha'i dkyil yangs na:ོ /sku gcig ma la sprul pa drug: /sprul pa drug la bka' nyan stodang:ོ /bka' nyan stong la phyag brnyan 'bum: /phyag brnyan nag mo 'bum gyi gtso:ོ /nag mo 'bum gyi sa/tso la phyag 'tshal so/:ོ /a ti pū ho:ོ pra ti ts+tsha ho:ོ ma hwa pū ru sha ho:ོ /ma gcig dpal ldan re ma ti:/rdo rje lha mo/ nag mo che:ོ /ma la dam rdzas gtsang ma'i masnu da pa 'bul ba ni:ོ /'bru sna lnga yi dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang : /go ro tsa na keng rus dri chen dang : /bsregs pa'i gsur dang rjen pa'i sha:ོ /mi dbang sman pa'i mam sar bcas: /sha khrag dmar gyi galta ra ma dang :ོ /dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa rnams:ོ /mchod par snga la cig dgyes par ma17da:ོ /mahā mam sa khā hi:ོ /ma hā rak+ta khā hi:ོ /mgī tsicu khā hi: /ma hā ba su ta khā hi:ོ /mahā bo ro tsa na khā hi: /ma hā keng ni ri ti la kha ram khā hi: /ma dus gsum kun nas ma sgrib ye shes spyan:ོ /ma sring chung ma bu ce/ bran

gu ru'i gsung bstan ma bangh+rus kye sgos gsol rnam dag byang gter 'khrul zad/lha :trī dza: dza: /ma mi bzad dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:/lcags kyi drel rta rkang gsum khri stengs na: /ma gcig dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti: /bajid cing 'gyeng ba'i tshul gye bzhugs su gsol: /ma ti ku la pad+ma sam bha wa: /sa ma ya tatrī lhan: /ma mi ma〉rin nam mkha'i dkyil yangs na: /sku gcig ma la sprul pa drug: /sprul pa drug la bka' nyan stong: /bka' nyan stong la phyag brnyan 'bum: /phyag brnyan nag mo 'bum gyi gco: /nag mo 'bum gye gtso la phyag 'tshal lo: /a ti pū ho: pra ti ts+tsha ho: ma hā pū ru sha do: /ma gcig dpal ldan re ma ti:/rdo je lha mo nag mo che: /ma la dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: /'bru sna lnga yi dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang : /go ro tsa na keng rus dri chen dang : /bsregs pa'i gsur dang jen pa'i sha: /mi dbang sman pa'i mam sar bcas: /sha khrag dmar gye gtor ma dang : /dam rdzas gtsang ma'i mchod pa rnams: /mchod par rol cig dgyes par mdzod: /mahā mam sa khu di: /ma hā rak+ta khu ti: /mahā tsicu khu di: /ma hā ba su ta khu ti: /mahā go ro tsa na khu ti: /ma hā keng ni ri ti la kha ram khu ti: /ma dus gsum kun nas ma sprib ye shes spyan: /ma sring chung ma bu tsha/ bran

106 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/mo'i tshogs: /ye shes mngon shes ldan pa'i thugs rje can: /mthu rtsal rmad du byung ba'i dgongs pa can: /sngon che nyid kyis zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i: /bstan pa srung phyir rtag tu grogs mdzod cig: dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod 'brin rdzogs so:༈ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sgos gsol rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med ni/ bh+yo: /bod khams (gsang gdangs )skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la: /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: /gnam mtsho phyug mor gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba: /bdag nyid chen mo do rje kun grags ma:/sku mdog mthing nag lhab lhub rin chen brgyan: /chu blun rgyal mtshan dang ni me long bsnams: /'byug la chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad//mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : bye: /mon yul jo mo lha ri gsang ba'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan lha ri do rje g.ya' ma skyong :/sgu mdog sngo skya rin chen dar gyes brgyan/ /shang lang dang ni zhags pa 'dzin pa ste: /rkyang la chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : phyo: /brin gyi bkris tshe ring gsang ba'i mtshan: /gangs kyi yum chen sgo rdo kun tu bzang : /sku mdog mthing dmar dar dang rus pas brgyan: /rdo rje dang ni bum pa bsnams pa ste: /seṅge chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : bh+yo: /yar 'brog mtsho bdag chen mo gsang ba'i mtshan/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul sa rje bgegs kyi gtso: /sku mdog nag mo rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: /ru mtshon rtse lnga dang ni zhags

106 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/mo'i snu gas:ོ /ye shes masngo na shes ldan pa'i thugs rje can:ོ /mthu rtsal rmad du byung ba'i dgongs pa can: /sngon che nyid kyis zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i: /bstan pa srung phyir rtag tu grogs mdzod cig:ོ dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod 'phrin rdzogs so:༈ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi lha sa gasku la rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med ni/ bh+yo: /thodad khams (gsang gdangs )lhamang ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la: /slob datu na chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: /gnam mtsho phyug mor gsang ba'i mtshan gasku/la ba:ོ /bdag nyid chen snu/ the rje kun grags ma:/sku malhanag mthing nag lhab lhub rin chen brgyan:ོ /chu srin rgyal mtshan dang ni me 'o/nga bsnams: /'brug la chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad//mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang :ོ bh+yo:ོ /mon yul jo mo lha ri gsang ba'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong :ོ/sku ma3/ga bye/ skya rin chen dar gyis brgyan/ /shang lang dang ni zhags pa 'dzin pa ste: /rkyang la chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchodad do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang :ོ bh+yo: /brin gyi bkris tshe ring gsang ba'i mtshan:ོ /gangs kyi yum chen sna rje kun tu bzang : /sku masnganag mthing dmar dar dang rus pas brgyan: /rdo rje dang ni bum pa bsnams pa ste: /seṅge chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad:ོ /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang :ོ bh+yo: /yar 'acadag mcho bdag chen mo gsang ba'i mtshan/ /'asngo ga chen 'khe ra 'dul —— rjo bgegs kyi gajo : /sku mthodag nag snu/ rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan:ོ /ru masnu na rtse lnga dang ni zhags

bstan ma bangh+rus kyi sgos gsol rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med/ 107pa bsnams: /dre'u chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /lha bu gangs dkar ma ni gsang ba'i mtshan: /gangs dkar sha med do ༄ spyan gcig ma: /sku mdog dkar mo dar tshon rin chen brgyan: /zor ba dang ni bum pa bsnams pa ste: /sha ba chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /ru mtshams jo mo kha rag gsang ba'i mtshan: /kha rag khyung btsun rdo je dpal gyi yum: /dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan rma byas brgyan: /rin chen sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub mdzes: /ḍā ma ru dang me+e long bsnams pa ste: /mi khyung chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad:/mchod do bstod do bskal pad thugs dam bskang: phyo: /byang bstod do dmar mtsho bdag gsang ba'i mtshan: /gser chen mkha' sding rdo je klu mo rgyal: /sku mdog dkar dmar dar dang rin chen brgyan: /sbrul chen dang ni par bu bsnams pa ste: /rta mace ga chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /sgom ra'i drung nas rab 'byams gsang ba'i mtshan: /rma ri rab 'byams sa/ je drag mo rgyal: /sku mdog dkar sngo dar zab rin chen brgyan: /be con dang ni 'khar gzhong bsnams pa ste: /'phar ba chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : spyo:/kong ngo'i kong btsun de mo gsang ba'i mtshan: /kong btsun de mo rdo je bod khams skyong / sku mdog spug nag dar dang rus pas brgyan: /mda' dar dang ni za ma tog gcig bsnams: /sprin gseb rlung bskyod bka'

bstan ma brtsus kyi cadas gasku la rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med/ 107pa bsnams: /dre'u chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad:ོ /mchodad wa blta da snga bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo:ོ /lha bu gangs dkar ma ni gsang ba'i mtshan:ོ /gangs dkar sha med do je spyan gcig ma:ོ /sku mthodag dkar mo dar tshon rin chen brgyan:ོ /sanar ba dang ni bum pa bsnams pa ste:ོ /sha ba chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /ma6)da chad bstod lhun bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /ru mtshams jo mo kha rag gsang ba'i mtshan:ོ /kha rag khyung btsun dod rje dpal gyi yum:ོ /dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan rma byas brgyan: /rin chen sna chodags dar gyi lhab lhab mdzes:ོ /ḍā ma ru dang me 'o/nga bsnams pa ste: /mi khyung chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad:ོ/mchod do bstod do bskal parwa thugs dam bskang: bh+yo:ོ /byang bstod do dmar masnu bdag gsang ba'i mtshan:ོ /gser chen mkha' lding ྅ rje klu sna rgyal: /sku masnga ga dkar dmar dar dang rin chen brgyan:ོ /sprul chen dang ni par bu bsnams pa ste: /rta mace)ga chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad:ོ /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /spom ra'i drung nas rab 'byams gsang ba'i mtshan:ོ /rma ri rab 'byams the rje drag mo rgyal: /sku mdog dkar rdzo dar zab rin chen brgyan: /be jo na dang ni 'khar gachodang bsnams pa ste:ོ /'phar ba chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : bh+yo:/bo nga wa'i to/nga btsun de snu gsang ba'i mtshan: /to/nga btsun de snu jo rje bod khams skyong / sku mdog slug nag dar dang rus pas brgyan: /mda' dar dang ni za ma lta ga gcig bsnams:ོ /sprin gseb rlung balha da bka'

108 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : spyo:/e gnyal lo re'i yongs bdag gsang ba'i mtshan: /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma: /sku mdog spug nag rin chen rus rgyan gsol: /lhab lhub dar dang 'brang rgyas bsnams pa ste: /mdzo mo chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : bh+yo:/gtsang gi jo mo nags rgyal gsang ba'i mtshan: /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: /sku mdog dmar mo dar dang lhab sgrub mdzes:/rin chen 'bar ba dang ni ting shags bsnams: /sha sa/ chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang : sbyo/bod kyi jo mo g.yu ri gsang ba'i mtshan: /g.yu yi dril bu rdo je zu le ma:/sgu mdog dmar ser rin chen du mas brgyan: /dril bu dang ni pad+ma bsnams pa ste: /stag la chibs nas bka' yi bya ra mdzad: /mchod do bstod do bskal par thugs dam bskang: bh+yo: /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi: /sngon gye dam tshig de ltar dran gyis la: /bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor bar chad sel: /bcol ba'i 'brin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sgos gsol sku mdog phyag mtshan bto/na pa sdu/gas 'dra min mang du sku/da 'dug na'ang / khungs btsun pa'i mchod bstod slob dpon pad+ma'i bskang gsol 'di'o// //(gong gsal dpal ldan lha tsho'i mchod 'khrin dang / bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sgos gsol rnam dag byang gter 'khrul med gnyis kham bu chu 'thag sku zhabs lhag pa tshe ring lags nas 'di ga sde tshan du gnang ba'i ma phyi bris ma dang dag cha ma phyi sor bzhag dpar cobaskyar bsgrigs zhus dag nges 'drongs song // //)

sgu zhabs lhag pa tshe ring lags ngo sprod/rdzo gtsang khul phag ri rnam rgyal dkar wa'i rdzong khongs kham bu chu 'thag mi ngo gus lhag pa tshe ring ne+e/ pha brgyud gzhis rtse byang ri'i mi brgyud skyed byed bsod nams dbang 'dus lags dang / ma brgyud 'brug ha dkar tshogs brgyud bsten dpa' chen gye mi brgyud ma bsod nams chog skyid gnyis kyi rigs myug tu/ bod rab byung 16 pa'i shing bya zla 5 tshes 10 dang /phyi lo 1945 gro'i dbyar zlar btsas shing / rang lo 10 son skabs pha ma rnam gnyis nas byams ljagang thugs gtsigs ci ches phag rir dge rgan bkrin can zur khang tshe rdor lags kyi zhabs sar sngar lugs bod kyi srol rgyun bod yig 'bri klog dang / dag gsum/ dgu zla cha phran blo 'dzin sogs gzhi rim slob gnyer byas/ rang lo 12 son skabs lha ldan rgyal sar krung shod bod ljongs slob 'bring khongs slob zhugs kyis gtso bo bod yig dang / ang rtsis/ rgya skad sogs slob sbyong du ched gnyer gnang byung rung /1958 tsam nas lha ldan du dus bde zhod 'jags med pa'i gnas dus zang zing la gyur stabs rang yul la phyir log byas/de nas rang lo 15 son skabs 1959 lor bod du dus 'gyur yo lang byung rjes 1961 lor rang lo 17 son skabs gro mo rdzong khongs nas slob dge'i 'os spyong ched rgyal rtse tshong gling du dge 'os

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gye dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 133sgo nas/ /chu bdag ma dang gzhi bdag la/ /rang rang cho gas gtor ma 'bul/ /nad bdag gdon rigs thams cad la/ /bden bdar chos bshad snying je bskyed/ ces gsungs pa ltar sngon 'gro'i cho ga rnams grub rjes chu tshan du ༄/ga mar zhugs skabs chu tshan to/na sa'i chu 'bo/ nas mi zhugs par chu gzhug ste drod 'jam yod sa nas zhugs te rim bzhin chu tsha sar 'dzul dgos/ chu tshan du zhugs pa'i dus tshod kyang / /dang po yun thung phyis nas bsrings/ /slar yang 'jog dus rim pas bskyungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por yun thung thung zhig dang / de nas 'dzul thengs rer zhugs yun je ring du gtong dgos/ chu tshan du zhugs thag gcod pa'i dus tshod zin la khad du nyin re las nyin re zhugs yun je thung du gtong dgos pa las zhugs yun ring po kho nas mjug bsdu ba sogs mi rung /)6 rang byung chu tshan la zhugs pa'i phan nus//phan yon dus ('dus )tshad rnying byer 'don/ /dreg grum 'bam 'bras rengs pa 'dul/ /'bras dang rma rgan rnag chu skem/ /dgye bo 'gugs shing sgur po brkyong / /skem po rgyas shing sgom po 'bri/ /chu ser 'or dang dmu chu skem/ /sha pags rtsa rgyus thigs ler 'don/ /drod 'phel mdangs gsal ro rtsa skyed/ /tshe dang lus zungs stobs 'phel zhing //g.yang rngul dri ngan lus tsha sel/ /'di la mi bsten nad pa rnams//malnga/nga ba bdag yid shin tu phangs/ sman rgyal gnyis pa mkhas dbang

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gyi dbe mtshan dpyad zhib/ 133sgo nas/ /chu bdag ma dang gzhi bdag la/ /rang rang cod gas galta ra ma 'bul/ /nad bdag gasnga na rigs thams cad la/ /bden bdar snu sa bshad snying rje bskyed/ ces gsungs pa ltar sngon 'gro'i cho ga rnams grub rjes chu tshan du thog mar zhugs skabs chu tshan 11na sadzirno chu 'go nas ci) zhugs par chu gzhug ste drod 'jam yod sa nas zhugs te rim bzhin chu tsha sar 'dzul dgos/ chu tshan du zhugs pa'i dus tshod kyang / /dang sngo yun thung phyis nas bsrings/ /slar yang 'chosig dus rim pas bskyungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por yun thung thung zhig dang / de nas 'dzul thengs rer zhugs yun je ring du galta nga dgos/ chu tshan du zhugs thag gathodad pa'i dus tshod zin la khad du nyin re las nyin re zhugs yun je thung du gtong dgos pa las zhugs yun ring ngo kho nas mjug bsdu ba sku gas mi rung /)6 rang byung chu tshan la zhugs pa'i phan nus//phan yon dus ('dus )tshad rnying byer 'don/ /dreg grum 'bam 'bras rengs pa 'dul/ /'bras dang rma rgan rnag chu skem/ /dgye bo 'gugs shing sgur po brkyong / /skem po rgyas shing sbom po 'bri/ /chu ser 'or dang dmu chu skem/ /sha pags rtsa rgyus thigs ler 'don/ /drod 'phel mdangs gsal ro rtsa skyed/ /tshe dang lus zungs bhobs 'phel zhing //g.ya' rngul dri ngan lus tsha sel/ /'di la mi bsten nad pa rnams//mthong ba bdag yid shin tu phangs/ sman rgyal gnyis pa mkhas dbang

134 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/g.yu lnga ga mabo na cad mchodag rgya gar du phebs skabs rgya gar gyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis khyed las mkhas pa therdzod na ji tsam sku da ces dris lan du/g.yu thog pa'i zhal snga nas/ nga las mkhas pa bod na gsum yod de/ kham bu tsha chu dang gcig phu ru tsha chu dang gnyis/ mang sgar cha tshu dang gsum zhes gsungs pa'i lo rgyus yod/7 yid zab byed dgos pa zhig ni/chu tshan la 'jug khar chams pa 'o/ga pa dang / tshad pas bshal ba sku/gas byung na/ ma nu bzhi thang 'thung ba dang / dmar bshal la mkhris phye bdun pa bcas bzas nas 'jug dbo/sa/ chu tshan la zhugs pa'i brgyud rim nang mgo bo bkru drags pa mi rung zhing / gal srid bkrus drags na skra bud pa dang / mig gi stobs 'phrog pa yin pas de ltar mi bya'o/(rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud kyi le'u nyer gsum pa lums kyi gzhung lugs bstan pa las kyang / /'grams dug tshad rnying byer zhing zhen pa dang / /'bras dang rma rgan sur ya rtsand dang / /rengs 'khums sgur po sha skams 'don par byed/)(gzhan yang / shel gong shel phreng dang / mes zhal/ bshad rgyud sogs las kyang / /the thal pho ba'i bad kan dril ba gcod/ /྅ thal chig thang ho/ ba'i bad kan bshig /bad kan myag byed ma bzhu ba la gnas/ /zas skom myag cing 'drul bar byed pa yin/)

134 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/g.yu lnga/ga mabo/na 'o/ maco ga rgya gar du phebs skabs rgya gar gye mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis khyed las mkhas pa ro/da na ji tsam mo/da ces dris lan du/g.yu sgog pa'i zhal snga nas/ nga las mkhas pa bod na gsum yod de/ kham bu tsha chu dang gcig phu ru tsha chu dang gnyis/ mang sgar cha tshu dang gsum zhes gsungs pa'i lo rgyus yod/7 yid zab byed dgos pa zhig ni/chu tshan la 'jug khar chams pa 'o/ga pa dang / tshad pas bshal ba sdu/gas byung na/ ma nu bzhi thang 'thung ba dang / dmar bshal la mkhris phye bdun pa bcas bzas nas 'jug dbo/sa/ chu tshan la zhugs pa'i brgyud rim nang mgo bo bkru drags pa mi rung zhing / gal blud bkrus drags na skra bud pa dang / mig gi stobs 'phrog pa yin pas de ltar mi bya'o/(rgyud bzhi'i ya gyal phyi ma 'khrin las rgyud kyi le'u nyer gsum pa lums kyi gzhung lugs bstan pa las kyang / /'grams dug tshad rnying byer zhing zhen pa dang / /'bras dang rma rgan sur ya rtsand dang / /rengs 'khums sgur po sha skams 'don par byed/)(gzhan yang / shel gong shel breng dang / zas zhal/ bshad rgyud sogs las kyang / /rdo thal pho ba'i bad gan dril ba gcod/ /rdo thal chig thang 14 ba'i bad gan bshig /bad gan myag byed ma bzhu ba la gnas/ /zas skom myag cing 'drul bar byed pa yin/)

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gyi dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 135(zas spyod dang byug pa/ /chu tshan du sdod pa'i dus rim nang rang nyid kye nad khams dang mthun pa'i kha zas za ba dang khyodad lam 'tshams par bya gal/ dper na/ pho ba'i me drod zhan pa dag gis lug sha'i khu ba 'thung ba'am/ gos dro por gyon pa dang / chu ser ram pags nad yod pa dag gis lug sha'i khu ba mi 'thung ba ma zad/ tsong sgog dang chang rag mi bsten par phag tshil la sogs pa khong par bsten dgos pa lta bu/ chu tshan la zhugs nas yar sgon skabs lus mi 'khyag pa byas te drod khams srung phyir mal gos mthug sngo/ khyodan pa dang / me+e dang nyi mar bas/ ba/ nad khams dang mthun pa'i sgo nas lus khams la bsku mnye bya dgos/ de yang/ rlung gi nad la mar rnying byugs te mnye ba dang / chu ser gye nad la rta bong gi tshil bu byug pa/mkhal ma'i nus pa nyams pa'i nad la sram gyi tshil bu byugs te mnye ba lta bu/mdor na chu tshan nas sgon ma thag lus thog tu rlung sil bu mi phog pa byas te zhun mar kyi bsgu mnye bya rgyu ha cang gal gnad che thog chu tshan nas don rjes gyon gos kyis lus po gtums pa dang / skom tsha po 'thung ba sogs kyi thabs shes la brten nas rngul chu gang mang thon thabs byed dgos/)8 chu tshan bsten pa'i nam dus ni/༈ /nam zla'i sgo nas brtag pa ni/ /chu ngan dus na chu tshan bzang / /ston mjug dpyid sob/sa mar ngo bzang / /rlangs pa sol pes chu bskol ltar//gyen du drang por 'gro dus bzang / /chu tshan khol zhing gyen mi 'gro/ /rlangs

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gyi dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 135(zas spyod dang byug pa/ /chu tshan du sdod pa'i dus rim nang rang nyid kyi nad khams dang mthun pa'i kha zas za ba dang spyod lam 'tshams par bya gal/ dper na/ pho ba'i me drod zhan pa dag gis lug sha'i khu ba 'thung ba'am/ gos dro por gyon pa dang / chu ser ram pags nad yod pa dag gis lug sha'i khu ba mi 'thung ba ma zad/ tsong sgog dang chang rag mi bsten par phag tshil la sku gas pa lto nga par bsten dbo sa pa lta bu/ chu tshan la zhugs nas yar nyonan skabs lus mi 'khyag pa byas te drod khams srung phyir mal gos mthug sngo/ ༷/na pa dang / me dang nyi mar bsro ba/ nad khams dang mthun pa'i sgo nas lus khams la bsku mnye bya dgos/ de yang/ rlung gi nad la mar rnying byugs te mnye ba dang / chu ser gyi nad la rta bong gi tshil bu byug pa/mkhal ma'i nus pa nyams pa'i nad la sram gyi tshil bu byugs te mnye ba lta bu/masnga ra na chu tshan nas thon ma thag lus jo ga tu rlung sil bu mi ho/ga pa byas te zhun mar gyi bsku mnye bya rgyu ha cang gal gnad che thog chu tshan nas snga na rjes gyon bo sa kyis lus po gtums pa dang / skom tsha po 'thung ba sogs kyi thabs shes la brten nas rngul chu gang mang thon thabs byed dgos/)8 chu tshan bsten pa'i nam dus ni/༈ོ /nam zla'i lha nas brtag pa ni/ /chu ngan dus na chu tshan bzang / /rdo na mjug dpyid sos/sa mar ngo bzang / /rlangs pa sol mes chu bskol ltar//gyen du drang por 'gro dus bzang / /chu tshan khol zhing gyen mi 'gro/ /rlangs

136 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/pa chur chags nus pa chung / /de yi rgyu mtshan 'byung ba gzhan/ /ma 'dres rang khams rgyas phyir 'o// /dbyar ston sa chu'i nus pa yang / /me rlung gis bskyed gyen la rgyu/ /de tshe rgya mtsho 'khol ba yin/ /zil rlung 'dres pas nus pa chung / /dgun dus sa chu rlung gsum gyi/ /rdo bas rgyas 'khyags shing 'thab pa las/ /nus pa sbubs su 'thum par byed/ ces pa ltar chu tshan la 'jug pa'i dus tshod dpyid ka bod zla gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i nang chu tshan la zhugs shing / de'i lan khyodan ka bod zla bdun pa dang brgyad pa dgu pa'i nang yang bskyar bsten na dus der gnam gshis kyi tsha grang snyoms pa dang/ chu tshan gyi nus pa che ba/ nad pa'i lus khams la 'aho/da bsten legs pa'i dge mtshan che bar ma1ran/ nad par mi 'aho/da pa'i rtags mabo/ yu 'khor ba dang / skyug mer langs pa/ snying g.yug pa/ lus la chu ser brdol ba'i za phrug dang / stod 'tshangs pa sogs byung tshe/ rlung shed che na.a gar bco lnga / khrag shed che na gser thang bco brgyad/ de min nor thang (nor bu bdun thang )dang / tsan+dan bco brgyad/ h+phos dkar bcu pa bcas gang dgos nad kyi rtags dang (thag nyer bzhugs pa'i sman pa byang sems can gyi zhal ngag las lam ston zhus te )bstun nas sprod dgos so/ gong du zhus pa bzhin chu tshan gyi nus pa mi shes na/ /sman chu chu tshan nang tshags kyi//'byung ba tsha grang 'phel 'grib las/ /phan sku/na byed las mi shes shing / /rten 'brel don la rmongs rnams ni/ /shes la mi 'dri rang bzo yis/ /'dod pa'i chu sman bsten rnams ni/ /phan med gcadad pa rim gyis shes/ /de dag rnams dang rjes 'jug la/ /phan par sems nas 'di ltar bkod//

136 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/pa chur chags nus pa chung / /de yi rgyu mtshan 'byung ba gzhan/ /ma 'dres rang khams rgyas phyir ro/ /dbyar ston sa chu'i nus pa yang / /me rlung gis bskyed gyen la rgyu/ /de tshe rgya mtsho 'khol ba yin/ /zil rlung 'dres pas nus pa chung / /dgun dus sa chu rlung gsum gyi/ /khyodabs rgyas 'khyags shing 'thab pa las/ /nus pa sbubs su 'thum par byed/ ces pa ltar chu tshan la 'jug pa'i dus tshod dpyid ka bod zla gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i nang chu tshan la zhugs shing / de'i lan ston ka bod zla bdun pa dang brgyad pa dgu pa'i nang yang bskyar bsten na dus der gnam gshis kyi tsha grang snyoms pa dang/ chu tshan gyi nus pa che ba/ nad pa'i lus khams la 'anyond bsten legs pa'i dge mtshan che bar mngon/ nad par mi 'phrod pa'i rtags mgo yu 'khor ba dang / skyug zar langs pa/ snying g.yug pa/ lus la chu ser brdol ba'i za phrug dang / stod 'tshangs pa sogs byung tshe/ rlung shed che nas gar bco lnga / khrag shed che na gser thang bco brgyad/ de min nor thang (nor bu bdun thang )dang / tsan+dan bco brgyad/ sgos dkar bcu pa bcas gang dgos nad kyi rtags dang (thag nyer bzhugs pa'i sman pa byang sems can gye zhal ngag las lam ston zhus te )bsnyun nas sprod dgos so/ gong du zhus pa bzhin chu tshan gye nus pa mi shes na/ /sman chu chu tshan nang tshags kyi//'byung ba tsha grang 'phel 'grib las/ /phan sku/na byed las mi shes shing / /rten 'brel don la rmongs rnams ni/ /shes la mi 'dri rang bzo yis/ /'dod pa'i chu sman bsten rnams ni/ /phan med gnod pa rim gyes shes/ /de dag rnams dang jes 'jug la/ /phan par sems nas 'di ltar bkod//

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gyi dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 137smras pa/ /'bo ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub/ /gasku bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed/ /gnyen wa'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel/ zhes pa'i tshan rig rang bzhin 'od dkar gyis/ /gso rig chu shel 'phreng ba'i 'dzin ma la/ /gzhom gzhig mi nus bskal pa'i bar du yang / /rgyud chen rnam bzhi'i dgongs don dge mtshan 'bar/ /'byung lnga'i bcud chen 'khol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'byung 'khrugs nad kyi sngug bsngal sel byed pa//'byung bzhi'i lha mo rnam bzhi'i mthu stodabs dang / /'byung rkyen rten cing 'brel ba'i ngo bo yin/ /phyi sdod 'byung lnga'i nus stobs rgyas pa'i rang byung mtshan mo'i nor bu yis/ /nang bcud skye 'tho'i 'byung nus mi nyams ku mud dkar po bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /nyes gsum nad kyis gtses pa'i sdug bsngal dri ma ma lus dag byed chab/ /yon tan ji bzhin brjod pa'i dge 'dis lus can nad las cadal gyur cigabod kyi rang byung chu tshan khag gcig gi mtshan/1 'jad kyi glang ma chu tshan/2 rgyal rtse'i skyin mkhar chu tshan/(nad rigs spyi dang / lhag par rus chag dang grum nad la shin tu phan par grags/)3 rtswa sgye mo'i rang byung 'khrud kyi rdzing bu nas 'khrud chu blangs/(lnga pa cesan pos chab bcenas/)

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gyi dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 137smras pa/ /'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub/ /gso bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bsgyed/ /gnyen po'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel/ zhes pa'i tshan rig rang bzhin 'od dkar gyes/ /gso rig chu shel 'breng ba'i 'dzin ma la/ /gzhom gzhig mi nus bskal pa'i bar du yang / /rgyud chen rnam bzhi'i dgongs don dge mtshan 'bar/ /'byung lnga'i bcud chen 'khol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'byung 'khrugs nad kyi sdug bsngal sel byed pa//'byung bzhi'i lha mo rnam bzhi'i mthu stobs dang / /'byung rkyen rten cing 'brel ba'i ngo bo yin/ /phyi sdod 'byung lnga'i nus stobs rgyas pa'i rang byung mtshan mo'i nor bu yis/ /nang bcud skye 'bo'i 'byung nus mi nyams ku mud dkar po bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /nyes gsum nad kyis gtses pa'i sdug bsngal dri ma ma lus dag byed chab/ /yon tan ji bzhin brjod pa'i dge 'dis lus can nad las grol gyur cigabod kyi rang byung chu tshan khag gcig gi mtshan/1 'jad kyi glang ma chu tshan/2 rgyal rtse'i spyin mkhar chu tshan/(nad rigs spyi dang / lhag par rus chag dang grum nad la shin tu phan par grags/)ga rtswa sgye mo'i rang byung 'khrud kyi rdzing bu nas 'khrud chu blangs/(lnga pa chen 11sa chab bzhes/)

bod kyi rang byung chu tshan gye dge mtshan dpyad zhib/ 145por sman chu tsha thing tsam dang dus yun skar ma bco lnga tsam dang/ de nas rim bzhin tsha ru dang dus yun ring du btang nas chu dza da gcig tsam rgyag pa / de nas rim bzhin nyung du gtong dgos de'i brgyud rim ni tsha drod chung ngu nas che ru dang/ dus yun thung ngu nas ring du gtong ba/ de nas chung du btang ste dpe de 'bru dbyebs lta bu zhig dgos/ dus tshod kyang gtso bo nad pa rang nyid kyi nad babs dang phan skyed la gzhigs te bdun phrag gcig nas bzhi bar rgyag dbo/sa/dmigs bsal do snang dgos pa/lums rgyag pa'i dus tshod nang rlung kha gnon pa'i zas sman bsten pa dang /skom tsha po btungs nas lus rngul thon par byas rjes ras 'jam gyes phyis la nad khams dang mthun pa'i byug pa rgyag dbo/sa/ mkhris tshad dang / khrag shed mchod ba/ snying nad/ rims tshad/ bshal skyugs drag po/ skya rbab/ kha zas dang ga 'gag pa bcas kyi skabs su lums rgyag mi rung ba bcas// //bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gso rig nad bcos bdud rtsi lnga lums kyi sbyor ba dang / bcos stabs phan yon blang dor gsal ba'i dkar chag lta bu 'di bzhin/ phyi nang sman gyis drags skyed ma thub pa'i skye 'gro nad kyis gdung ba sku ngal can rnams kyis rang lugs gso dpyad bdud rtsi lnga lums kyi bcos thabs dge bed bde blag tu spyod slad da lam rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan gyi phan skyodan dang chabs cig b.lo/da pa yin lags na/ zhib phra rang gzhung dbus sman rtsis khang du sngar gyi lha rje mkhas pa dam pa gong

146 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig shi ngo mtshar khyad chos/ma rim byon gyi man ngag phyag len nyams med du gnas yod par skabs so so'i 'tsho byed sman pa mkhas pa dag bsten gtugs bdud rtsi lnga lums 'phrod bzhes gnang sgo tshul ldan 'chug med ngos chos srid legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi rtsalus rten bde nas bde bar 'tsho thabs la 'bad brgyan dam gnyer gnang 'os ci nas che ba de don dgongs bcangs mdzod// //

146 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/ma rim drodan gyi man ngag phyag len nyams med du gnas sku/da par skabs sku/ so'i 'tsho byed sman pa mkhas pa dag bsten gtugs bdud rtsi lnga lums 'phrid bzhes gnang cad tshul ldan 'chug med cags chodas srid legs cho gas kun gyi gzhi rtsalus rten bde nas bde bar 'tsho thabs la 'bad brtson dam gnyer gnang 'os ci nas che ba de don dgongs bcangs mdzod// //

gnas chen brag phug mā ra ti ka'i gnas bshad/༈ོ e ma hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mtshungs med mi mchog dbang po chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa'i slob dpon che/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul sku de la 'dud/ /gnas mchog dam pa de'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyud nyi zla kha rjodar las/ /'o/ rgyus don gyis ma shes na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/zhes gsungs pas/ lo rgyus cung zad cig zhu na/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa nub cadags bde ba can gyi zhing khams/ rdo na pa phun sum chorgags pa rigs bdag 'od dpag tu med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang ba la/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa tshe bdag rigs lnga sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sogs pas zhus pa'i sngorar/ /tshe rgyud tan+t+ra bco brgyad la sogs pa gsungs pa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gser gyi shog gu la baiḍūr+ya zhun mas mkha' 'gro'i brda yig tu bris nas/ rin chen sna lnga'i sgrom bur bcug ste ri bo ta la'i shar phyogs gsang ba'i brag phug mā ra rki kar sbas so/ de nas shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das rjes o rgyan yul dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho

gnas chen brag phug mā ra ti ga'i gnas bshad/sno e ma hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mtshungs med mi mchog dbang po chos kyi je/ /thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa'i slob dpon che/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul sku de la 'dud/ /gnas mchog dam pa de'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyud nyi zla kha spyor las/ /lo rgyus don gyes ma shes na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/zhes gsungs pas/ lo rgyus cung zad cig zhu na/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa nub ༷/gas bde ba can gyi zhing khams/ khyodan pa phun sum co gas pa rigs bdag 'od dpag tu zad pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang ba la/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa tshe bdag rigs lnga sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sogs pas zhus pa'i ngor/ /tshe rgyud tan+t+ra bco brgyad la sogs pa gsungs pa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gser gyi shog gu la biḍūr+ya zhun mas mkha' 'gro'i brda yig tu bris nas/ rin chen sna lnga'i sgom bur bcug ste ri bo ta la'i shar phyogs gsang ba'i brag phug mā ra ti gar sbas so/ de nas shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das rjes sa/ rgyan yul dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho

148 rang byung bdud rtsi chab tshan khag gcig gi ngo mtshar khyad chos/dkyil pad+ma'i sdong po la sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas sku 'khrungs te/ mtshan yang gu ru mtsho skyes rdo je zhes grags so/ de nas gu ru rin po che mā ra ti shar byon pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi rgyud sde rnams bka' bab dang bcas te gnang / der zhag bdun bsgrubs pas tshe dpag med rigs lnga dngos su byon te dbang bskur/ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku thob bo/ /der che'i sgrub thabs dpag tu med pa mdzad de/lha lcam matā ra ba sogs la gnang bas kyang 'chi ba med pa'i tsho'i rig 'dzin thob bo/ /gzhan yang slob dpon hūṃ chen kā ra dang / bi ma mi tra sogs che'i rig 'dzin zob pa mang du byung ngo // //gu ru'i rnam thar ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho las kyang /nga 'di nas shar gyi phyogs na ri bo ta la zhes bya ba yod pas der 'gro ba yin gyi/ khyed rang yang zhag gsum gye mtshan mor shar phyogs su kha ston la/kho bo spyi gtsug tu sgom ste gsol ba 'debs kyin shog dang / ngas kyang khyed bsu ba la 'ongs kyis gsung pa'i nyin mo de nyid la nam mkha' nas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi babs nas byung ste/ gser gyi rdo je rgya gram gdan du bting pa'i dbus su gu ru rin po che bzhugs su gsol nas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi pos phyogs bzhi nas btegs te pho brang ri bo ta la'i sto nub phyogs mā ra ti ka zhes bya ba dbyebs zla gam du yod pa/ kha shar stor ltas pa/ nyi ma 'char sla la rgas phyi ba/ dus rgyun du ste tog gi char 'bab pa 'ja' tshon gyi gur 'thibs pa/ sgos kyi dri dang ldan pa tsan+dan gye tshal yod pa/rigs gsum mabo/na 11sa byen gyis brlabs pa bkra shis pa/ nyams dga'

gnas chen brag phug mā ra ti ga'i gnas bshad/ 149ba zhig yodapa der byon nas bzhugs so/ de'i tshe lha lcam ma ra ba de khog pa'i snying thon pa ltar song ste/ za hor gyes yul khams dang rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer ram mdangs gsum gye me+e lam ltar song nas/ sa cig tu sdod mi tshugs par/ sems kyis gtad so gang yang zad par/ bar do'i shes pa ltar khyam khyom yid yed por gyur to/ de'i tshe zas nor longs spyod dang bcas pa skad cig kyang yid la mi dran zhing / sdod ma tshugs pa zug zer gyis nam byed la pho brang gi sgo btol te phyir thon nas nyin mtshan du kha shar phyogs su lta zhing phyin pas/ nam langs tsam na dur khrod kyi gling mi med pa / lung pa stong pa kha byang du bstan pa/ phu na brag ri nag cing rtsub pa mtshan cha'i phung po ltar rang rong du yod pa/ bar na nags tshang dang rdza sogs mun ltar 'thibs pa mdo na chu sgra 'brug ltar sdir ba/ nyi ma mig gis mi mthong zhing / nam mkha' sngo khyug ge yod pa'i rong khung dog po 'jigs shing ya nga ba/ phar bos nas brag cha lhang lhang las med pa/ tshur nyan na chu sgra shod shod 'ong ba zhig tu sleb bo/ de nas yang phar phyin pas/ nub ri chen 14 zhig gi grib ma ma 14ga pa'i thang mtshams shig tu sleb bo/ de nas yang phar phyin pas grong khyer stong pa'i yul gog cig tu sleb bo/ de nas khang stong mang po sgo cad gtsigs pa/ thog sdib pa/la la khang rong song ba/ la la byed ral ba/ ra ba dang rtsig pa thams cad la shing phung skyes pa/ khang stong thams cad 'jag skyar phyur ba/ khang pa'i nang thams cad ni mi rus kyi phung por yod pa/ srang de'i bar thams cad la gos hrul gyis dum bu long long du yod pa/ zhing thams cad 'jag skya
